FlowStore session

credentials, apiUser, installDir, integration, frameworkConfig,

RunStore session + atoms
[one per agent run]
RUN_SESSION_KEYS: runPhase, outroData, outroDismissed, pendingQuestion,
taskNotice, mintHandoff, settingsConflicts, settingsOverrideKeys
atoms: tasks, statusMessages, eventPlan, handoffText, tokenUsage

ControlState

version, currentScreen, tasks, statusMessages, eventPlan, handoffText,
setupQuestions, actions,
